items.excerpt: A new Microsoft patent describes designers prompting an AI with text, images and audio to generate a game's objectives, sidequests, NPCs, dialogue and items, then regenerating content live from players' facial expressions and speech.
items.title: Microsoft want to record your face and feed it to a generative AI, telling it to go off and design a game from your frown
items.matched_keyword: AI game dialogue / AI quest generation

items.excerpt: NVIDIA details DLSS 5's 3D-Guided Neural Rendering with granular controls meant to preserve artistic intent, alongside NVIDIA ACE updates for AI-driven game characters and new RTX Kit capabilities for developers.
items.title: What's New for Game Developers: DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, NVIDIA ACE Updates, and New RTX Kit Capabilities

items.excerpt: NVIDIA released RTX Kit and RTX Mega Geometry 2.0 SDKs, giving developers neural rendering, path tracing and streaming of very high geometric detail. Overlaps with the NVIDIA dev-blog item; pick one.
items.title: NVIDIA Unleashes The Next Chapter of Neural Rendering & Path Tracing With RTX Kit SDK While RTX Mega Geometry 2.0 SDK Gives Devs the Ability To Stream Insane Levels of Detail

items.excerpt: OpenDLSS-NR reimplements DLSS 5's neural rendering in Vulkan, hitting 7.8 ms at 1080p on an RTX 4070 and running in web browsers, opening the AI look-altering filter beyond NVIDIA's stack.
items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Gets Open-Source Vulkan Reimplementation, Runs on RTX 40 GPUs and Even in Web Browsers
items.matched_keyword: neural rendering (note: planner steers away from DLSS 5 mods)

items.excerpt: Needle In A Haystack Simulator's creator apologized as copycat games flood Steam; GamesRadar notes many of the clones evidently rely on generative AI, extending the vibe-coded fast-follow problem to Valve's store.
items.title: "The Robloxification of Steam": Creator of viral game apologizes after slop rip-offs flood Valve's store

items.excerpt: Square Enix updated FFXIV's Materials Usage License to allow more physical fan-made goods, while explicitly banning generative AI and 3D printing in fan merch.
items.title: Final Fantasy 14 relaxes guidelines for non-commercial fan-made merch. New rules prohibit use of generative AI and 3D printing

items.excerpt: In a fuller response to the backlash, Level-5 said some suspected AI artifacts in its Yo-kai Watch and Professor Layton trailers were human mistakes, but apologized for careless AI use in parts of its videos. This follows the Level-5 story already published 09-13, so treat it as a follow-up.
items.title: Level-5 says some suspected AI oddities from trailers were actually human errors, apologizes for fueling doubt with "careless use of AI" in some of its videos

items.excerpt: Twitch is testing an AI-powered stream coach that suggests how creators can improve their channels, alongside an AI content-training opt-out.
items.title: Twitch Plans To Shove More AI Down Creators' Throats With Stream Coach Tool

items.excerpt: King Art's creative director and senior game designer lose to Dawn of War 4's hard-difficulty enemy AI in gameplay footage, which shows how the RTS's opponent behavior was tuned. This is classic game AI, not generative AI.
items.title: 'The Boss Is Supposed to Win!' - Watch Hard Difficulty AI Orks Wipe the Floor With the Creative Director and Senior Game Designer of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4

items.excerpt: The team behind the retro survival horror Tenebris Somnia positions its live-action cutscenes and practical effects as a deliberately human-made craft statement against AI.
items.title: 'AI could never make Tenebris Somnia,' the 2D retro survival horror with live-action cutscenes and practical effects
items.matched_keyword: AI game art (marginal: anti-AI craft framing)

items.excerpt: A solo Cambridge developer's Godot colony sim Luminids uses a character-cognition (CRI) system where characters make individual decisions from memories, beliefs and relationships. The tech is being spun out as a separate AI company, LuminidsAI.
items.title: 'Luminids' 캐릭터 인지 기술, AI 회사로 확장

items.excerpt: Com2uS Platform unveiled Hive Axyl at Hive Tech Summit 2026. It is a next-generation backend platform built for AI-driven game development and launches officially on the 30th.
items.title: 컴투스플랫폼, AI 백엔드 '하이브 액실' 30일 출시

items.excerpt: Com2uS Platform sponsored the first AI Game Sound Design Competition (AI GSDC 2026) in Pangyo. Hive is serving as an official AI solution in Korea's 2026 game-production AX (AI transformation) support program.
items.title: 컴투스플랫폼, 'AI 게임 사운드 디자인 대회' 후원

items.excerpt: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS, its most expressive audio models, which can generate custom character voices and direct multi-speaker scene dialogue via AI Studio and the Gemini API.
items.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello

items.excerpt: NVIDIA shows agentic AI workflows that inspect 3D scenes, author simulation data in OpenUSD, add physics properties and validate environments. It is aimed at digital twins, but it applies to 3D scene assembly pipelines.
items.title: How to Use AI Agents to Prepare 3D Scenes for Simulation

items.excerpt: Unity's walkthrough video covers installing and using its official Claude Code plugin to build in Unity from the terminal. The plugin itself was covered on 09-13, so this is a follow-up and likely a near-duplicate.
items.title: Your guide to the official Unity plugin for Claude Code
